claims.statement: The keyword search agent uses a three-condition cache check (no previous fetch, query changed, or >4 hours elapsed) to decide whether to re-run the agent graph or use cached job results.
The feedback workflow updates thread memory without re-invoking the agent graph, performing a local re-filtering of cached jobs instead.
The Harbor CI evaluation runs against frozen job API responses to verify the agent's filtering logic in isolation from LLM or network dependencies.
